name: Margarita
description: Tequila, orange liqueur, and lime—salted rim optional, brightness mandatory.
history: A mid-century classic with contested origin stories. What matters at the bar is fresh lime, honest tequila, and orange liqueur with enough character to matter.
whyItWorks: Agave’s earthiness meets citrus snap; orange liqueur bridges sweetness and aroma. Salt amplifies flavor without adding sugar.
ice: Shaken; up or over fresh ice
steps: If using salt, rim half the glass with lime and salt.
Shake tequila, Cointreau, and lime juice with ice.
Strain into a coupe, or over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
techniqueNotes: Prefer Cointreau for individual premium cocktails.
Finest Call Triple Sec is fine for batching, frozen drinks, parties, and lower-cost variations.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Smooth cristalino profile that drinks clean in a Margarita.
Confirmed Kirkland tequila from the photo inventory—solid everyday pour.
The preferred orange liqueur for a polished single cocktail.
Use for batching and party builds when cost matters more than polish.

substitutions.notes: Grand Marnier makes a richer, cognac-tinged Margarita.
